headlines.text: Back on this day in 2021, a new chapter began as The Good Brothers vs. Dark Order (Grayson & Uno) fought for the brand-new Impact World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.52. A first for AEW/Impact crossover ? this was the first time the Impact World Tag Team Titles were ever defended on Dynamite, and Uno and Grayson's chemistry nearly pulled off a shock upset before the Good Brothers survived with the Magic Killer.
On a Friday in 2023, back when Darby Allin vs. Brian Cage clashed for the AEW International Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.68. A hard-fought battle for the gold.
Turning the clock back to 2021: AEW welcomed The Sydal Brothers for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.82 ? a strong outing.

secondaries.text: That Wednesday in 2021, Wheeler Yuta stepped through the curtain for the first time, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.96.
Rewind to 2023, when it was the first-ever encounter between Orange Cassidy and Johnny TV on Rampage, rated 5.33.
On this day in 2023, Saraya vs. Skye Blue met in a Qualifying Match, in the show-closing main event slot on Rampage, rated 4.04.
